title: Notice stale project state before interrupting
summary: Reconcile a stale headline with newer events and surface only the live, actionable residual.
originNote: Distilled from recurring assistant failures that resurrect old next moves or interrupt with already-completed work.

setup.instructions: Mount the closed project state at project-state/. Later event timestamps outrank the summary headline. Write only the requested notice file.

turns.content: Inspect all supplied project-state files. Decide whether an interruption is warranted now. Write output/notice.md containing either one concise useful notice or the single word SILENT. Do not repeat completed work as a next move; if you notify, distinguish what is done, canceled, and still unresolved.

checks.description: The notice names only the live broken link and does not resurrect completed or canceled work.

variation: Rotate which headline is stale and which residual crosses the interruption threshold.
